Mozilla-derived CA bundle provenance
===================================

The bundled PEM roots are from the curl project CA bundle at
https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem, generated from Mozilla's Included CA Certificate List.
Bundle date: 2026-10-20 13:32:40 GMT
SHA-256: 796f1389bfea13c0ed78f663b765baaff54a508e5483786bd6ece73c5e3e3cbe

The CA bundle is distributed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. BearSSL's `brssl ta`
tool converted it into `trust_anchors.c`; the generated trust anchors are bundled statically
with the Browser. Refresh the PEM bundle and regenerate that source together.
